status: STUDY / reporting only - LOCAL; production engine (tutor_cat, scenario_cat_lib, calibrate_mirt) untouched; nothing committed; calibrated on OBSERVED gemini-3 labels (Rule 0).

op_point.reach_rule: SE_ability (EAP posterior SD at stop) <= target ONLY
op_point.stop: dense 321-node EAP posterior-SD over +/-8; plateau delta=0.005/W=3; cap 70; MWLE theta at stop
op_point.oos: k=5, seed 20260729, per-fold refit (production M2PL MML-EM, 7 GH, ridge 0.01, clamp; within-fold zero-variance filter)

curation.policy: MINIMAL Rule-0 (OBSERVED gemini-3 labels; auto zero-variance drop only; NO near-separation / pass-imbalance exclusion)

debias_convention: HYBRID: of-record leaderboard = OBSERVED theta + SE_total error bars (SE_judge dominant) + annotated 1.83x cohort de-bias caveat (posterior CI 1.33-2.97x, NOT applied per-model); SECONDARY = full-bank per-model theta_debiased band (Spearman 0.993, 0 violations); op-point per-model theta_debiased = directional-only for the weak tail (op-point Spearman 0.778).
reach_definition: SE_ability (EAP posterior SD at stop) <= target ONLY

leaderboard.convention: OF-RECORD: observed op-point MWLE-at-stop theta + SE_total (incl SE_judge) error bars + annotated 1.83x cohort de-bias caveat (NOT per-model debiased).

se_judge.note: gemini-3 is strict (alpha~0.45 false-fail, beta=0 false-pass) -> SE_judge is the DOMINANT floor and observed theta is biased DOWN.

confusion.pooling: conceptual_understanding = own alpha (15 gold-PASS >= 8); quantitative_procedural(3) + unknown pool to overall alpha (0.45)

cohort_debias_factor.direction: UP (beta=0 => p_true = p_obs/(1-alpha)); firm; magnitude band wide (20 gold-PASS cells)

tier_b.verdict: Tier B <= Tier A: refitting absorbs judge noise into item params; frozen-bank Tier A is the conservative of-record.

se_judge.precision_lever: tighten alpha via a judge-FAIL-enriched gold audit (more true-passes gemini wrongly failed), NOT more cells.

spearman_note: rankings robust to judge layer (full-bank Spearman 0.993; op-point 0.778 = weak-tail reshuffle only); observed theta / pass-rate carry the cohort de-bias band.
slope_caveat: OOS slope ~= 0.879 = mild absolute-scale compression (genuine bank property; CAT MWLE pulls extremes toward centre). Rankings + pass-rate faithful; only absolute-theta units shrunk.
